name: Shield-Maiden's Favor

automation.text: A spiritual echo of a Valhallan shield-maiden appears and interposes herself between the triggering attack and its target, then the shieldmaiden vanishes. The triggering attack's damage is reduced by 1d10 plus your spellcasting modifier.

casttime: Reaction, which you take when you or an ally takes damage
description: A spiritual echo of a Valhallan shield-maiden appears and interposes herself between the triggering attack and its target, then the shieldmaiden vanishes. The triggering attack's damage is reduced by 1d10 plus your spellcasting modifier.
higherlevels: The damage reduction increases by 1d10 for each spell level above 1st.
